title: Improve usability of the dive list filter
summary: **Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.** The usability of the dive filter dialog has a lot of room for improvement. It can be somewhat frustrating to use at the moment. **Describe the solution you'd like** 1. The "Advanced Search" jump into a maximised frame on PC. Consistency between the standard search and advanced search would be preferable 2. The "Advanced Search" expands the search criteria significantly, but there are still a lot of attributes that aren't searchable. This should be extended to all available attributes 3. It is inconvenient to have to scroll to the bottom of the standard search to Clear or Apply filters. These should be pinned to the top of the dialog, and remain visible even when scrolling 4. having all tags available to select is fine, but is tedious if there are dozens of tags (eg from dive computer imports, unless cleaned up). Especially with other search parameters below the tag list 5. It is not possible to search the "Notes" field. This can be done using "Search dives" from the dive list instead of "Filter dives", but then you lose the ability to scroll in the left pane and view in the right, as well as the ability to multi-select and edit.
